kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتبختر (form IIq)
# نَتَبَخْتَرُ (natabaḵtaru) /na.ta.bax.ta.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# نَتَبَخْتَرَ (natabaḵtara) /na.ta.bax.ta.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# نَتَبَخْتَرْ (natabaḵtar) /na.ta.bax.tar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
